text_en: Then Job answered:
text_cn: 约伯回答说：

text_en: “I have heard many such things; miserable comforters are you all.
text_cn: 像这样的话，我听了许多；你们的安慰反使人烦恼。

text_en: Have windy words no limit? Or what provokes you that you keep on talking?
text_cn: 这些风凉话何时了？或者有什么事迫你非说不可？

text_en: I also could talk as you do, if you were in my place; I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you.
text_cn: 若是你们处在我的境遇中，我也会说像你们所说的话，也会花言巧语讥笑你们，向你们摇头。

text_en: I could encourage you with my mouth, and the solace of my lips would assuage your pain.
text_cn: 我也会以口舌宽慰你们，摇唇鼓舌来减轻你们的痛苦。

text_en: “If I speak, my pain is not assuaged, and if I forbear, how much of it leaves me?
text_cn: 我若讲话，痛苦并不停止；我若闭口不言，难道痛苦就离开我？

text_en: Surely now God has worn me out; he has made desolate all my company.
text_cn: 现今天主的确叫我厌倦，使我每个亲人都远离了我；

text_en: And he has shriveled me up, which is a witness against me; my leanness has risen up against me, and it testifies to my face.
text_cn: 使我憔悴，以指证我；使我消瘦，当面非难我。

text_en: He has torn me in his wrath, and hated me; he has gnashed his teeth at me; my adversary sharpens his eyes against me.
text_cn: 他在愤怒中撕裂我，窘迫我，向我咬牙切齿；我仇人锋利的眼睛常盯着我。

text_en: They have gaped at me with their mouths; they have struck me insolently on the cheek; they mass themselves together against me.
text_cn: 他们张开大口想吞噬我，责骂着打我的面颊，一起拥上前来攻击我。

text_en: God gives me up to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.
text_cn: 天主将我交于不义之人，将我丢在恶人手中。

text_en: I was at ease, and he broke me in two; he seized me by the neck and dashed me to pieces; he set me up as his target;
text_cn: 我原来安宁，他却折磨我，抓住我的脖子，粉碎我，又拿我当作他的箭靶。

text_en: his archers surround me. He slashes open my kidneys, and shows no mercy; he pours out my gall on the ground.
text_cn: 他的箭矢四面射击我，射穿我的腰，毫不留情，使我的胆倾流于地。

text_en: He bursts upon me again and again; he rushes at me like a warrior.
text_cn: 他将我撕裂粉碎，有如武士向我跑来。

text_en: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and have laid my strength in the dust.
text_cn: 我缝麻衣包裹我的皮肤，使我额角插入尘土。

text_en: My face is red with weeping, and deep darkness is on my eyelids,
text_cn: 我的脸因哭泣发红，我睫眉间满是暗影；

text_en: though there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.
text_cn: 我的手虽没有行过残暴的事，而我的祈祷又往往纯正。

text_en: “O earth, do not cover my blood; let my outcry find no resting place.
text_cn: 地啊！不要掩盖我的血。愿我的呼声无休息的余地！

text_en: Even now, in fact, my witness is in heaven, and he that vouches for me is on high.
text_cn: 看啊！连现今在天上有我的见证，在高处有我的中保。

text_en: My friends scorn me; my eye pours out tears to God,
text_cn: 我的哀号上彻于天，在天主前我的双目流泪不止。

text_en: that he would maintain the right of a mortal with God, as one does for a neighbor.
text_cn: 惟愿人与天主之间有一中人，犹如人与人之间一样！

text_en: For when a few years have come, I shall go the way from which I shall not return.
text_cn: 因为我的年数将尽，快要走上那条一去不返的路途。
